# The pointer words of BOF3.exe's initialised .data: runs of `words` 4-byte words from
# `pc` whose value points into the PC image (`to`: the section it points at). A disc's
# word there is its own build's address, so base/exe/ leaves them unfilled; the PC's
# pointer-shaped words every disc that places them holds equal are numbers, not
# pointers, and are not listed. Addresses and counts only (CLAUDE.md rule 1).
